name: Reading feed
purpose: Assistant-side publication policy/catalog only; never connects the service to a mailbox. App ingestion requires an explicit allowed source ID.

policies.navigation: Small stable topics; publication stays a source badge/filter, never a sender-created category
policies.tldr: Both editions always AI/TLDR, preserving all substantive topics and edition provenance
policies.allowlist: Exact normalized sender plus stable list identity when available AND positive publication-shape/content gate. Trusted received authentication evidence is required. Unknown identities/template changes go to private review.
policies.labels: Unread/inbox/Gmail category do not determine inclusion or ranking. Quarantine spam/trash/sent/draft from automatic ingestion.
policies.sponsors: Hide sponsorship by default; preserve adjacent editorial. Exclude referral/unsubscribe/giveaway/trade-now/subscribe/discount/navigation CTAs.
policies.narrative: One attributed issue/story card, optional public URL; split only independently titled stories; keep citations with parent; never invent URLs.
policies.dedup: Group known-tracking-normalized public URLs while retaining all appearances; opaque private mailbox/message identity. Assistant may recognize cross-mailbox issue duplicates by publication/date/content hash. Never dedup by title alone or lose legacy IDs/feedback.
policies.privacy: No private mailbox config/IDs/Gmail links/recipients/raw MIME/account data in public repo. Never export credentials/unsubscribe tokens/subscriber tracking/security footer. Set URL absent unless a clean public target is safely derived/verified.
policies.unknownSource: Private review queue, never auto-enable or auto-create category tabs
policies.mixedSource: Route each public article into existing topics; retain source badge; uncertain content goes to review
policies.feedback: Prefer explicit human preferences, weak click/expand evidence; exclude automated/bulk-classifier actions and unknown actors. Dismissal ambiguous; rank before hiding, preserve undo/provenance.
